mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Discovery Sport 2.2 Diesel engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full reconditioned or rebuilt Land Rover Discovery Sport 2.2 Diesel engine typically costs between £2,000 and £5,000 for the unit itself, depending on the level of rebuild.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of EGR or turbo failure in a Land Rover Discovery Sport 2.2 Diesel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early detection is critical to preventing secondary damage to your 224DT engine. Look for unexplained coolant loss, white smoke from the exhaust, or a sweet smell from the engine bay. Sudden loss of power, excessive black smoke, or the vehicle entering limp mode are major warning signs.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in an early Land Rover Discovery Sport 2.2 Diesel?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends heavily on the vehicle's current condition and market value. For well-maintained examples valued over £7,000, a warranted reconditioned engine protects your investment. For sub-£5,000 models, the replacement cost approaches the vehicle's value, making a used engine or evaluating part-exchange value a more practical choice.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the 2.2 Diesel and the newer 2.0 Ingenium in the Discovery Sport?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 2.2 Diesel (224DT) is a Ford-sourced Duratorq engine used only in the 2014-2015 launch models. The 2.0 Ingenium (204DTD) replaced it from late 2015 onwards, offering improved fuel efficiency and lower emissions. While the 2.2 is generally robust, the 2.0 Ingenium has its own distinct maintenance profile.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Discovery Sport 2.2 Diesel engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A straightforward supply and fit of a reconditioned 224DT engine typically takes 2 to 4 days at a specialist workshop. This allows time for proper bedding-in procedures, fluid checks, and a thorough road test to ensure the 4x4 systems are functioning correctly.

problems.group: EGR Cooler Leaks & Turbo Actuator Failure
problems.h4: EGR Cooler Leaks & Turbo Actuator Failure - Why the Land Rover Discovery Sport 2.2 Diesel 224DT Loses Power
problems.rootCause: Carbon buildup and thermal stress cause the EGR cooler to crack and leak coolant into the intake, while the turbocharger wastegate actuator is prone to mechanical wear, leading to boost loss and limp mode.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace EGR cooler, clean intake manifold, and replace turbo actuator.
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early and there is no secondary internal engine damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if coolant ingestion has caused hydrolock, or the engine has very high mileage.

problems.recommendation: If your Discovery Sport 2.2 Diesel is exhibiting early warning signs like minor boost loss or EGR-related coolant consumption, a specialist preventative service is a cost-effective solution. However, if the engine has suffered timing chain rattle or coolant ingestion, a full reconditioned replacement is the most reliable long-term investment.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Tensioner Wear - Why the Land Rover Discovery Sport 2.2 Diesel 224DT Rattles
problems.rootCause: Wear in the timing chain tensioner can lead to chain stretch, causing a distinct rattling noise on cold starts and risking catastrophic valve train damage if ignored.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace chain, guides, and tensioners with updated specification parts.
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early and compression remains good.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the chain has skipped, causing internal damage, or the engine has high mileage.
